model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the relationship between the Co-occurrence Number and ACC (%) for six different methods: Base, FT, IKE, MEND, MEMIT, and ROME. The x-axis is labeled "Co-occurrence Number" and uses a logarithmic scale (base 10) with visible major tick marks at 0, 10^1, 10^2, and 10^3. The y-axis is labeled "ACC (%)" and uses a linear scale ranging from approximately 37 to 68, with major tick marks at intervals of 5 units from 40 to 65. All six methods are represented by solid lines and show an overall increasing trend across the four data points plotted at approximate x-values of 3, 30, 300, and 3000. The "Base" method is represented by a black line with circle markers, starting at an ACC of approximately 38 at x=3, rising to roughly 41.5 at x=30, reaching about 43.5 at x=300, and ending at approximately 44 at x=3000. The "FT" method is shown as a blue line with downward-pointing triangle markers, beginning at roughly 40 at x=3, increasing to 43 at x=30, reaching 46 at x=300, and concluding at approximately 47.5 at x=3000. The "IKE" method is depicted by a red line with upward-pointing triangle markers, starting at about 43 at x=3, rising to 45 at x=30, reaching 46.5 at x=300, and ending at roughly 49.5 at x=3000. The "MEND" method is represented by a brown line with diamond markers, beginning at approximately 44.5 at x=3, increasing to 48.5 at x=30, rising to 54 at x=300, and finishing at about 56.5 at x=3000. The "MEMIT" method is shown as a purple line with hexagon markers, starting at roughly 43.5 at x=3, increasing to 51 at x=30, reaching 53 at x=300, and ending at approximately 54.5 at x=3000. Finally, the "ROME" method is depicted by a green line with square markers, beginning at approximately 51 at x=3, rising to 57 at x=30, increasing to 62.5 at x=300, and concluding at roughly 66 at x=3000.
